purpose: Rust parser and lifecycle fixture coverage manifest for Hyperliquid adapter parity gates.

fixture_groups.product_scope: HIP-4 outcome and operational lifecycle scope

scoped_blockers.summary: Hyperliquid Rust fixture coverage now has a compact manifest, but parity closure remains assigned to RADP-012.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Closed by RADP-011 compact manifest coverage for Hyperliquid HTTP, WebSocket, account/funding, and outcome operational fixture groups.

scoped_blockers.summary: Hyperliquid product support is scoped to perps, spot, and HIP-4 outcomes.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as supported with constraints: Hyperliquid product support remains perps, spot, and best-effort HIP-4 outcomes.

scoped_blockers.summary: Hyperliquid market data is scoped to L2 MBP and venue-specific custom streams.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as supported with constraints: Hyperliquid market data remains L2 MBP plus all-mids and open-interest custom streams.

scoped_blockers.summary: Hyperliquid execution maps market orders to IOC limits and has product-specific restrictions.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as supported with constraints: Hyperliquid execution keeps IOC-derived market orders, current TIF restrictions, CLOID handling, and HIP-4 outcome limits.

scoped_blockers.summary: Hyperliquid operational lifecycle needs release-gate parity closure.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as supported with constraints: Hyperliquid WebSocket post execution, CLOID cache, address resolution, clearinghouse reconciliation, and optional outcome polling are release-gate visible through the operational manifest group.

scoped_blockers.summary: Optional Hyperliquid Python/PyO3 surfaces remain until the removal gate.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Deferred to the Rust-only removal gate because RADP-012 does not authorize deleting optional Python/PyO3 surfaces.
